description:
Log in to ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (https://localhost:8080) with credentials administrator / administrator. 

Go to Admin > Asset Management.
1. Create a new **Product Type** named 'Network Switch'.
2. Create a new **Product** named 'Cisco Catalyst 9200L-24P-4G' under the 'Network Switch' type.
3. Set the Manufacturer for the product to 'Cisco Systems' (create the manufacturer if it doesn't exist).

Ensure all records are saved.
